fullSource:
use default
use Raster.IMAGE

let image = IMAGE(320, 240)

image.set_pixel(100, 100, 255ub, 0ub, 0ub)

let p = image.pixel(100, 100)

write_line("pixel (100, 100) is ({p.red}, {p.green}, {p.blue})")

image.write("pixel.png")

image.show("pixel.png")
